question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm institutional control as general secretary, president, and Central Military Commission chairman, with recent Beidaihe conclave discussions and ongoing anti-corruption purges across military and party ranks reinforcing loyalty ahead of the 21st Party Congress. At age 73, he shows no public signs of retirement or succession planning, having removed term limits in 2018 and elevated allies while sidelining potential rivals. Trader consensus at 95% for "No" before 2027 reflects the absence of credible challenges or health disclosures in opaque elite politics, consistent with historical patterns of extended CCP leadership tenures. Rare disruptive scenarios, such as acute medical events or abrupt elite fractures, remain the primary variables that could still alter the timeline despite current consolidation.
